briefing.text: On News, Information Technology stays first (buzz 88.4, up 7.1 on the day and 1.4 on the week, mentions up 387%, sentiment 0.26) on NVDA, MSFT, AMD, CRWD and ZS. Utilities rose most (buzz up 20.0, mentions up 432%, DUK, NEE, FLNC) and Financials climbed from rank 8 to 4 (buzz up 16.9, but down 3.4 over the week; BAC, MS, UBS). On X, Information Technology leads at 93.4 (up 1.1, mentions up 46%, sentiment 0.12; NVDA, MU, IREN), and Healthcare is up 28.7 on the week. On Reddit, Information Technology leads at 95.2 (sentiment -0.03), Healthcare is up 18.2 on MEDS, and Consumer Staples slipped 1.7 (WMT, PEP, KO).

DLTR #1: Q3 traffic growth of 3.8% and a Q4 EPS forecast of $2.46-$2.66; stock up about 11% on the day, so the news explains the rank.
DKS #2: raised FY2026 EPS guidance and comps to 3.3%-4%, lifting retailers such as Nike; explains the rank (stock up 14.6%).
DELL #3: earnings preview coverage only, with the report due after the close; explains the attention, and the stock is down 13.4%.
BBY #4: raised its annual outlook and added shopping through ChatGPT and Gemini; explains the rank.
DG #5: mostly Dollar Tree read-through headlines, with its own earnings on 12-03; the ranking comes from sympathy, not its own news.
ZM #6: analysts note the strongest enterprise growth in 13 quarters, with some caution on Q4; explains the rank.
MDT #7: Q2 revenue miss, stock down 4.6%; explains the rank.
EBAY #8: heavy put options activity and an Adyen co-founder headline; only partly explains the rank.

DLTR ranks first on the strongest mix: attention (1.28x normal, 97th percentile), attention on X (1.41x, 99th), volume (1.27x) and a 3.1-sigma move, with earnings today as the catalyst. DKS is a close second (score 0.954): the highest volume of the three (2.03x normal) and a 4.2-sigma move, but weaker attention (0.71x). DELL is third, down from second: volume is 1.60x normal and open interest is high, but it is the only one of the three falling (-13.4%) and its earnings come after the close. All three carry the earnings 11-24 catalyst.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
